question: When performing a standard SAP HANA database system installation, which users will be created or validated during that installation? (Choose two.) A. <sid>crypt B. SYSTEM C. SAP<SID> D. sapadm

Which file system locations do you need to specify when installing the SAP HANA multi-host database system using the default settings? (Choose two.) A. /hana/shared B. /usr/sap/hostctrl C. /usr/sap/<SID> D. /hana/log/<SID>
How does SAP HANA encrypt the data persistence layer? A. By page level B. By row level C. By table level D. By column level
Which services can you stop in the SAP HANA cockpit from the SYSTEMDB Manage Services app? (Choose two.) A. Compile server B. Daemon C. Preprocessor D. Index server

Which characteristics describe an SAP HANA multitenant database container (MDC) system? (Choose three.) A. A multitenant database container system is identified by a single system ID (SID). B. The name server provides index server functionality for the system database. C. Each tenant database runs its own compile server and the preprocessor server. D. The name server owns information about the location of tables and table partitions in databases. E. Database isolation increases the isolation between tenant databases on operating system level.
For an SAP HANA tailored datacenter integration (TDI) approach, what is the additional disk space factor required during delta merge operations? A. 3.0 B. 2.0 C. 1.2 D. 1.6
Which file systems are supported for the data and log volumes of the SAP HANA 2.0 database system? (Choose two.) A. GPFS B. Btrfs C. OCFS2 D. XFS

You plan to update an AS ABAP-based SAP system with the role "Quality Assurance System". What does SAP recommend you do before you start Software Update Manager (SUM) for this system? (Choose two.) A. Import the modification adjustment transports from the update of the "Development System". B. Follow the instructions from SAP Note 'Central Note - Software Update Manager' for the used version of SUM. C. Apply the latest SAP Host Agent patch. D. Execute the SAP Load Generator (SGEN) transaction for invalid loads.

What are prerequisites to use the Software Update Manager (SUM) to apply SAP Support Packages to an AS ABAP-based SAP system? (Choose three.) A. The SUM archive must have been provided to the SAP Host Agent. B. The SAP Host Agent must have been configured by SUM. C. The latest SAP kernel patch must have been applied to the SAP system. D. The SUM archive must have been extracted. E. A suitable Stack XML file must exist.

When performing a local client copy with transaction SCCLN, in which client is it recommended to start the client copy? A. The source client B. The target client C. A client different from both the source and the target client

Using standard tp settings, what are features of transport strategy "Queue-Driven Transports, Mass transports" but NOT of transport strategy "Queue-Driven Transports, Single transports"? (Choose three.) A. The 'Import All Requests' function is available. B. Return Code 8 is considered a successful import. C. The import process can be scheduled in the background. D. Using the 'Import Request' function causes the imported transport requests to remain in the import queue. E. Return Code 16 is caused by an erroneous object in a transport request.

How does a Transport of Copies differ from a Workbench Request? (Choose two.) A. When importing, the transport request is not forwarded to subsequent delivery systems. B. When creating the transport request, a target system without a consolidation route can be selected. C. After the import, repository objects in the target system are classified as copies. D. No cofile is created, when releasing the transport request with the Transport Organizer (SE09).

What is the purpose of a pre-production system in an AS ABAP-based four-system landscape? (Choose two.) A. To isolate the next urgent correction or project cycle. B. To detect cross reference errors. C. To implement urgent corrections. D. To act as a failover system for the production system.

You are logged onto an AS ASAP-based SAP system. What happens when you release a task of a transport request that contains changes to a program? A. A temporary version is created in version management. B. The repository locks are released. C. A data file and a cofile are created. D. The object list of the task is handed over to the transport request.

When importing a transport request, which steps are executed by a batch job? (Choose three.) A. Activation of dictionary objects B. Activation of ABAP programs C. Distribution of dictionary objects D. Move nametab E. Import of dictionary objects

Which of the following actions can be executed in transaction Edit Profile Parameters (RZ11)? (Choose two.) A. Display the value of individual profile parameters B. Download values of all profile parameters in one step C. Set new values for profile parameters in profile files D. Change values of dynamic profile parameters
In an SAP S/4HANA server system, which data can you NOT maintain for a technical user? A. Roles B. Groups C. Parameters D. Address

In an AS ABAP-based SAP system you have triggered a test print and you notice that no spool request has been generated. What does SAP recommend you check to analyze the issue? A. Developer traces of the spool work processes B. Assignment of device type to output device C. Transaction Dumps (ST22) and Application Log (SLG1) D. The log of the host spooler on the corresponding host

In ABAP programs, what are features of ABAP SQL that are not available with native SQL? (Choose two.) A. Database independence B. Execution without a work process C. Use of the AS ABAP data buffer D. Execution of ABAP programs as database procedures

Which of the following background jobs has the lowest priority? A. Class C job with a target server B. Class C job without a target server C. Class A job without a target server D. Class A job with a target server

When restarting an Additional Application Server instance, which profiles are evaluated? (Choose two.) A. Default profile B. Instance profile of the Additional Application Server C. Instance profile of the Primary Application Server D. Instance profile of the Central Services instance

You want to create an ABAP task list in a development system to transport it to the production system. What must you do? (Choose two.) A. Assign the task list to a customizing transport request. B. Assign the task list to a package. C. Assign the task list to a workbench transport request. D. Activate the task list.
Which work process types can create spool requests? (Choose two.) A. Background B. Dialog C. Update D. Spool

Which tools can be used to create SAP Fiori catalogs? (Choose three.) A. SAP Fiori launchpad content manager (/UI2/FLPCM_CUST) B. SAP Fiori launchpad content aggregator (/UI2/FLPCA) C. SAP Fiori launchpad application manager (/UI2/FLPAM) D. SAP Fiori launchpad designer (/UI2/FLPD_CUST) E. SAP Fiori launchpad settings (/UI2/FLP_CUS_CONF)

You have passed the initial authentication for an SAP Fiori transactional app. Which authentication technology is used for subsequent OData calls of this app? A. X.509 client certificates B. SAML 2.0 C. SAP logon tickets D. ABAP Session Security

You want to perform rapid activation for SAP Fiori. In what order should you run the task lists? A. 1. SAP_FIORI_FOUNDATION_S4 2. SAP_GW_FIORI_ERP_ONE_CLNT_SETUP 3. SAP_FIORI_CONTENT_ACTIVATION B. 1. SAP_FIORI_FOUNDATION_S4 2. SAP_FIORI_CONTENT_ACTIVATION 3. SAP_GW_FIORI_ERP_ONE_CLNT_SETUP C. 1. SAP_GW_FIORI_ERP_ONE_CLNT_SETUP 2. SAP_FIORI_FOUNDATION_S4 3. SAP_FIORI_CONTENT_ACTIVATION D. 1. SAP_GW_FIORI_ERP_ONE_CLNT_SETUP 2. SAP_FIORI_CONTENT_ACTIVATION 3. SAP_FIORI_FOUNDATION_S4

In an SAP S/4HANA system, a target system alias, FIORI, is maintained for source system alias S4FIN. Which connection is relevant for the extraction of back-end catalogs with alias S4FIN? A. FIORI_HTTPS B. FIORI_RFC C. S4FIN_HTTPS D. S4FIN_RFC
Which processes can run optionally as part of the Central Services instance of an AS ABAP-based SAP system? (Choose two.) A. Message Server B. SAP Web Dispatcher C. RFC Gateway D. Enqueue Server

Which steps are mandatory to configure an AS ABAP-based SAP system for outbound mail? (Choose two.) A. Maintain the default domain (transaction SCOT). B. Create a system user with authorization profile S_A.SCON (transaction SU01). C. Maintain and activate the SAPconnect node in the ICF (transaction SICF). D. Maintain and activate an SMTP node (transaction SCOT).

What can you do to determine the SAPUI5 patch level in an AS ABAP-based SAP system? A. Use the program WDG_MAINTAIN_UR_MIMES B. Execute the ICF service/sap/public/bc/ui5_ui5 C. Check the version of software component SAP_UI D. Use the program /UI5/UI5_UPLOAD_PATCH_TO_MIME
